messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look calendar of the **Canadian statutory holidays that create long weekends** in 2023.  
(For brevity, I’ve listed only the *federal* holidays that apply nationwide; provincial holidays vary and may add extra long weekends in certain regions.)

| Date (2023) | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|-------------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Mon | New Year’s Day | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat–Mon). |
| **February 20** | Mon | Family Day (Alberta & Saskatchewan) | 3‑day weekend (Sun–Mon). |
| **April 7** | Fri | Good Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri–Sun). |
| **April 10** | Mon | Easter Monday (some provinces) | 3‑day weekend (Mon–Tue) – not a federal holiday but observed in several provinces. |
| **May 22** | Mon | Victoria Day | 3‑day weekend (Sun–Mon). |
| **July 1** | Sat | Canada Day | Observed July 2 (Mon) → 3‑day weekend (Sat–Mon). |
| **September 4** | Mon | Labour Day | 3‑day weekend (Sun–Mon). |
| **October 9** | Mon | Thanksgiving | 3‑day weekend (Sun–Mon). |
| **December 25** | Mon | Christmas Day | 3‑day weekend (Sun–Mon). |
| **December 26** | Tue | Boxing Day | 3‑day weekend (Mon–Tue) – often combined with Christmas for a 4‑day break. |

### Quick Summary
- **New Year’s Day** (Jan 1) – 3 days (Sat–Mon)  
- **Family Day** (Feb 20) – 3 days (Sun–Mon)  
- **Good Friday** (Apr 7) – 3 days (Fri–Sun)  
- **Easter Monday** (Apr 10) – 3 days (Mon–Tue) (provincial)  
- **Victoria Day** (May 22) – 3 days (Sun–Mon)  
- **Canada Day** (Jul 1) – 3 days (Sat–Mon) (observed Jul 2)  
- **Labour Day** (Sep 4) – 3 days (Sun–Mon)  
- **Thanksgiving** (Oct 9) – 3 days (Sun–Mon)  
- **Christmas Day** (Dec 25) – 3 days (Sun–Mon)  
- **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) – 3 days (Mon–Tue)

These dates will help you plan your long‑weekend getaways for 2023. If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Civic Holiday in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.), let me know and I can pull those in as well!
